description: What the runs of a report are over: the corpus, how much of it, and the time for a task. It is the summary.json of a report, and every run of the report is over the same.

corpus.description: The release that the corpus is of, as v0.5.0, or for a run from a checkout of the repository what git describe says about its commit, as v0.5.0-3-gabc1234.

collections.description: How many collections the tasks are of.

cases.description: How many cases the tasks are of. A case is two tasks, one for each direction, and runs over a sample may have one of them only.

tasks.description: How many tasks each run has.

labelled_tasks.description: How many of the tasks have a label. The shares of a report are shares of these.

timeout.description: The seconds that the checker had for one task.
